verdict.rationale: Appwrite Storage has a first-party preview endpoint that resizes, crops, converts format, sets quality, adds borders and rotates from a single upload. It also offers face- and saliency-aware cropping via gravity=auto, and assets are served through Appwrite CDN, so developers need no image pipeline of their own. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the image transformation endpoint.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve resized or transformed images from storage without running my own image pipeline

citations.quote: Use the preview endpoint to resize, crop, convert format, set quality, add borders, and rotate from a single upload.
Pass gravity=auto and YuNet looks for a face first.
Upload, organize, and serve images, videos, documents, and other assets through Appwrite CDN
